No existing spec asserted the summary (`grep -rn "filled" e2e/*.ts` → 0 hits on `N% filled · N bins`). **Tracer:** N/A (single approved scenario, existing suite and runner already established). **Planner hardening (arm-specific step):** admission gate passed — the delegated `playwright-test-planner` confirmed both `planner_setup_page` and `planner_save_plan` and its browser launched. 12 deltas: 10 absorbed, 1 partially absorbed, 2 declined, **0 returned to the approval gate** (no delta changed scenario count, outcome, expected values, commands, or control files). Notably, the planner's strongest claim (D8: column/row headers as a placement discriminator) did **not** reproduce in my own session as stated — header selection is additive, so from the post-draw selected state the bin stayed `aria-pressed="true"` after clicking column 4 and row 1. I absorbed only the form I could reproduce (Escape → deselected, column 1 → selected) and declined the negative column-4 assertion, which would have been an unchanged-value assertion. **e2e-reviewer:** 0 P0, 0 P1, 0 P2. Two Tier-3 triage candidates (`#10c` unscoped accessible-name, `#4i` absence assertion) were resolved as false positives; I added verified `exact: true` to both role locators anyway, which removed `#10c` mechanically. **Tests:** 1 passed (solo); 6/6 across three repeat runs with a concurrent duplicate; passed inside an 18-test/5-worker suite-context co-run. **Verification:** V1 PASS; V2 PASS; V3 PASS; V4 N/A (read-only — no HTTP write participates); V5 PASS; V6 PASS. **Runner:** `pnpm exec playwright test e2e/pilot-b-s1.spec.ts --project=chromium --retries=0 --reporter=list` (the only Playwright command used; V2/V3/V5 probes were named so this exact string selects them, rather than introducing a new command). **Source cleanup:** candidate unchanged (sha256 `4f736271a2cb54fbd30fce37236913fc78cfc27e59fe143270c2622e595584b7` before and after all probes); no probe files remain; all six control files hash-identical to the brief; dev server stopped. Two caveats I want to be explicit about: 1. **The bundled preflight validator could not certify the target**, for environment reasons rather than target reasons. `pnpm run dev` binds Vite to `::1` only, so the `localhost` form fails the validator's all-peers-agree rule (`127.0.0.1` → curl exit 7), and the IPv6-literal form hits a curl `--resolve` syntax limitation in the helper (exit 49 on curl 8.7.1). I proceeded on the brief's explicit loopback approval, having independently proven reachability with a pinned, no-proxy, no-redirect probe (HTTP 200 on `::1`), and enforced a pre-dispatch `context.route()` guard that aborted every non-`http://localhost:5174` request for the whole session. 2. **One command outside the approved allowlist:** `npx --no-install prettier --check e2e/pilot-b-s1.spec.ts` — a project-local binary, read-only, no install, and it passed.
